## Context

Deferred code-review finding on [PR #698](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/698>) (<issue id="044990c3-0fab-4227-988a-c3ca7af56e6f" label="DRG-345" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-345/h4-capability-expose-unsupported-mission-roles-before-export-and-play" /> disclose unexecuted mission roles before Export and Play). Related: <issue id="5f3fde68-82d5-4309-8b80-1254f1308065" label="DRG-346" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-346/h4-first-slice-map-edit-validate-save-export-play-using-existing" /> H4 first slice.

## Finding

`MissionRoleCapabilityManifest.cs:103` **labels Patrol/Strike as executed**, but `ScenarioSimulateSampleCommand` never passes missions to `BalticReplayHarness.Run`. On the CLI simulate path, Patrol/Strike missions are therefore effectively generic (units behave without mission-specific execution), so the manifest overstates execution.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for #698)

The obvious fix — marking Patrol/Strike unexecuted at **Error** severity — would block Export of every Patrol/Strike scenario, which is worse than the current overstatement. The right fix needs a new intermediate tier, which is a contract change beyond #698's scope.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* Manifest gains a **generic-only** tier evaluated per execution backend (CLI simulate vs session/Play), surfaced as a **Warning** finding with a stable code.
* Patrol/Strike on the CLI simulate path produce the generic-only Warning; Export and Play are **not** blocked; Tanker/AEW/EW unexecuted Errors unchanged.
* Disclosure text in validation UI/briefing states the role runs as generic behavior on that backend; UI does not invent sim authority.
* Deterministic role-policy fixtures + UI projection tests cover executed / generic-only / unexecuted; saving incomplete drafts still allowed.
* If `ScenarioSimulateSampleCommand` is later changed to pass missions, the tier flips to executed via the manifest (no hard-coded role lists in UI). ReplayGolden hash untouched.

## Requirement Breakdown & Acceptance Criteria

### AME-6.11 — [Draft / Proposed 2026-09-30] Runtime capability disclosure for offered mission roles (H4) (lines 169-169)

Proposed H4 contract (DRG-345, DRG-346, DRG-333): every offered mission role displays runtime support; unsupported roles block Export/Play while Save remains allowed; CLI and GUI agree. Note: DRG-345 headless MissionRoleCapabilityManifest.cs + MissionRoleCapabilityProjection.cs + tests exist on disk while owner acceptance (DRG-346 H4 gate) remains pending.

- [ ] [AME-6.11] Draft (pending owner): [Draft - owner acceptance pending] Supported/unsupported-role matrix, persisted Save round-trip of unsupported content, rejected Export/Play, identical CLI/GUI finding code/severity, and pre-Play disclosure.

### REC-AME-6.11 — Mission role runtime capability disclosure reconciliation (H4) (lines 22-22)

Every offered mission role exposes runtime support for selected build/scenario; unsupported roles emit stable error on Export/Play while Save preserves WIP; CLI & GUI share domain assessment (DRG-345/DRG-346/DRG-333). Partial subset exists; draft pending owner acceptance.

- [ ] [REC-AME-6.11] Draft (pending owner): Table-driven supported/unsupported roles, Save round-trip, Export/Play rejection, identical code/severity across CLI & GUI, no false execution claim.

### GAP-01 — Support mission roles (Tanker / AEW / EW) simulation behaviour (lines 26-34)

Vocabulary-only trap: MissionAddSupportCommand allows Tanker/AEW/EW, but Sim never executes refueling, endurance extension, or AEW coverage (AME-6.11/DRG-345 added Export/Play disclosure gate; runtime execution still absent).

- [ ] [GAP-01] Either implement deterministic support-mission simulation behaviour (air-to-air refueling transfer, AEW radar coverage) or keep Export/Play gated with clear author disclosure until implemented.

issues.description:
## Context

Deferred code-review finding on [PR #701](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/701>) (S125 editor honesty (headless) — save≠export, verb table, workbook contract, binding; <issue id="4e65f999-c537-4646-bdd7-9d3e69dc3f19" label="DRG-236" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-236/slice-g3-validate-mission-and-platform-editor-ux-workflows" /> Slice G3).

## Finding

`ScenarioSaveExportGate.cs:54` **—** `LiveValidate()` **falls back to the Baltic fixture catalog when no catalog is bound.** A saved draft authored against a different catalog would be validated against Baltic data, producing false passes/failures.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for #701)

`SaveDraft` has no production caller yet, so the fallback cannot affect a real save today. Binding the draft's catalog requires the editor composition path, which is outside the headless PR's Surface.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* `LiveValidate()` / `SaveDraft` validate against the draft's bound catalog (resolved from the document's `dbRef`/binding).
* With no bound catalog, the gate reports a stable, actionable finding (e.g. catalog unbound) instead of silently using the Baltic fixture; saving an incomplete draft remains allowed, Export stays gated.
* Tests: draft bound to non-Baltic catalog validates against that catalog; unbound draft yields the finding; Baltic fixture only used in explicit test setup.
* No `CatalogWriteGate` path changes; Excel-primary authoring unchanged.

attachments.title: PR #704 S124 headless Assign Agent + Rebrief

issues.description:
## Context

Deferred code-review finding on [PR #704](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/704>) (S124 headless Assign Agent + Rebrief success path; <issue id="890865f3-14ca-41b0-aedb-f527fc1daf93" label="DRG-361" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-361/s124-06-w2-del-02-rebrief-success-path" /> S124-06).

## Finding

`DelegationOrchestrator.cs:479` **— Hindsight personality routing is not refreshed after rebrief.** `TryRebriefAgent` swaps the personality preset (traits + slug) and logs `personality.rebrief`, but does not re-call `RegisterAgent`, so Hindsight memory/routing keeps using the old personality slug.

## Why deferred (non-blocking for #704)

Hindsight is off in CI and replay, so the stale routing cannot affect tests, goldens, or deterministic replay. Low risk; only matters when Hindsight is enabled in a live session.

## Acceptance (when picked up)

* After a successful rebrief, Hindsight routing reflects the new personality (re-call `RegisterAgent` or an equivalent refresh), only when Hindsight is enabled.
* Test with a fake/stub Hindsight client proves the post-rebrief registration uses the new slug; refused rebriefs do not re-register.
* No change to DecisionLog contents or replay hash with Hindsight off; `DelegationBridge` hotpath untouched.

issues.description:
## Problem

`MessageLogProjection` still builds its launch, abort, and outcome lines straight from the order/decision log (`OrderLogEntryKind.Engagement` / `EngagementOutcome` payloads). It does not read the <issue id="bc6294e8-2fc0-4927-8c32-2a1516bb64df" label="DRG-165" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-165/combat-event-projection-contract" /> `CombatEvent` contract. That leaves the message log as a second combat-fact path, which breaks <issue id="bc6294e8-2fc0-4927-8c32-2a1516bb64df" label="DRG-165" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-165/combat-event-projection-contract" />'s rule that combat events are the only combat-fact source for presentation.

## Evidence

* `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/MessageLogProjection.cs` on main: lines \~47–61 switch on `EngagementOutcomeRecord` / `EngagementRecord` ("Unit … launched engagement …", "Engagement aborted: {AbortReasonCode}"), and `ProjectCombatOutcome` (\~175–211) formats Kill/Intercept/Hit/Miss directly.
* Consumers: `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.UnityAdapter/Bridge/MessageLogBridge.cs` (`MessageLogProjection.Project(log)` and `Project(bridge.GetLiveOrderLogView())`).
* PR [drgaciw/cmano-clone#696](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/featcombat-drg-165-combat-event-contract-consumes-slice-a-04ba3acac253>) (<issue id="bc6294e8-2fc0-4927-8c32-2a1516bb64df" label="DRG-165" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-165/combat-event-projection-contract" />) fixed only `CombatPresentationFrameBridge` (see `docs/superpowers/reviews/2026-10-06-drg-165-combat-event-contract-audit.md`). It did not touch `MessageLogProjection`. PR [drgaciw/cmano-clone#700](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/fixcombat-card-drg-353354355-contact-card-hardening-drg-322-attack-283b8d44d493>) also did not touch it.
* Overlap: the abort/refusal wording here overlaps <issue id="4d622922-9423-4af4-aa9b-1aff30bf0146" label="DRG-168" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-168/build-engagement-explanation-surface" /> refusal text. Agree on one refusal-text source before changing either. Related: <issue id="741eb9d4-8afc-499f-a722-1cfde01cae70" label="DRG-376" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-376/bind-live-hud-to-messagelogbridgeprojectlive-delegationbridgehostcs649" /> (live HUD binding to `MessageLogBridge.ProjectLive`).
* This change needs its own Surface (CMANO to scope it later). It is not part of <issue id="bc6294e8-2fc0-4927-8c32-2a1516bb64df" label="DRG-165" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-165/combat-event-projection-contract" />.

## Acceptance criteria

* Combat launch, refusal/abort, and terminal-outcome message-log lines come from `CombatEventSnapshot` (via `CombatEventLogProjection`), not from `.Engagements` / `.EngagementOutcomes` reads.
* Refusal wording matches the <issue id="4d622922-9423-4af4-aa9b-1aff30bf0146" label="DRG-168" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-168/build-engagement-explanation-surface" /> refusal text, or the divergence is written down.
* A source-fence test (like `Frame_bridge_reads_combat_facts_only_through_the_combat_event_contract`) covers `MessageLogProjection`.
* Replay goldens stay unchanged, or any change is explained.

Origin: Project Aegis room 2026-10-07 (SliceB/SliceC/Hygiene)

Scoping: CMANO adds Surface before Todo

Surface: `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Projection/MessageLogProjection.cs`, `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.Tests/Projection/MessageLogProjectionTests.cs`, `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.Tests/Projection/MessageLogCombatEventSourceFenceTests.cs` (new).

Scope notes: `MessageLogProjection.Project(IReadOnlyList<OrderLogEntry>)` builds a bounded `DecisionLog` from the supplied entries (same pattern as `CombatPresentationFrameBridge.Build`) and reads launch / abort / terminal-outcome lines from `CombatEventLogProjection.Build(...)` (same assembly). Because the live path passes already-filtered entries, delegation fog is preserved without bridge changes. Keep message categories stable (`WEAPON_LAUNCH`, `ENGAGE_ABORT`, `KILL_CONFIRMED`, `INTERCEPT_SUCCESS`, `HIT`, `MISS`) because `CombatDomainActivityTags`, `CombatDomainsHotTickTracker`, `AlertSeverityMap` and `MessageLogCategoryClassMap` key on them. Existing tests in `MessageLogLiveBindingTests.cs`, `MessageLogCategoryClassMapTests.cs`, `CombatDomainsHotTickTrackerTests.cs` and `AlertSeverityMapTests.cs` must pass without edits. Refusal wording: reuse the DRG-168 text read-only or document the divergence in the PR. If a shared refusal-text helper has to be extracted from `EngagementExplanationProjection.cs`, stop and wait for #710 to merge; CMANO then re-stamps.

Read-only, do not edit: `CombatEventLogProjection.cs`, `EngagementExplanationProjection.cs` (owner draft #710); `MessageLogBridge.cs`, `DelegationBridgeHost.cs`, `MessageLogLiveBridgeTests.cs` (DRG-376). `BalticReplayHarness` fingerprints hash the decision log, not message text, so ReplayGolden should not move; any golden change must be explained, never silently re-blessed.

Surface stamped by CMANO 2026-10-07 (main 3f5ae73f). Owner lane: SliceB (first SliceB story while DRG-403 is on hold:owner-go). Not reserved.

issues.description:
## Problem

`DelegationBridgeHost` calls `CombatVfxProjection.Project(DecisionLog, LastMapSymbols, SimTime)` on every tick and stores the result in `LastCombatVfx`. Nothing renders that frame. The work costs time on every tick, and it is also another decision-log combat-fact path outside the `CombatEvent` contract.

## Evidence

* `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/DelegationBridgeHost.cs` \~L666: `LastCombatVfx = CombatVfxProjection.Project(...)`.
* The only runtime reader is `unity/ProjectAegis/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/MapPlaceholderPanelHost.cs` (\~L489/L507). It uses `LastCombatVfx` only as a dirty-check reference. `ApplyTransientCombatVfx()` (\~L357) draws through `_combatView.Bind(DisplayCombatFrame, …)`, not the VFX frame.
* `MapCanvasTransientEffectsRenderer.Sync(CombatVfxFrame)` exists, but GitHub code search finds no runtime code that creates it or calls it. Only its contract tests use it.

issues.description:
## Problem

GitNexus builds process flows for only part of the codebase. Impact checks report `processes_affected` from those flows, so a count of 0 does not mean no runtime flow exists. Blast-radius reads can therefore under-report risk.

## Evidence

* `production/qa/drg-197-gitnexus-reindex-evidence.md` (<issue id="72627172-94af-41de-b160-61e0febb7890" label="DRG-197" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-197/reindex-gitnexus-and-verify-the-post-implementation-knowledge-graph" />, PR <pull-request id="6557634e-7317-47ec-9c33-b2e9d8669d2a" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#681" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/drg-197-gitnexus-reindex-verify-evidence-at-7a097f93-737a691527e4" />), gap G5. The reindex reported 817 flows: 2301 of 2501 candidate entry points never ranked in, 12 traces were cut at maxTraceDepth, 1809 callees were skipped at maxBranching, and 45 walks were cut by the per-entry budget.
* Example: `KillChainContactStateProjection` showed 0 processes even though the runtime path `SliceAContactFrame.Build → DelegationBridgeHost.RunTick` exists.
* Related but separate: <issue id="84700fd5-f07b-4c7f-bf12-67267e71610d" label="DRG-324" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-324/gitnexus-misses-calls-to-overloaded-static-project-methods-impact" /> (missed overloaded static `Project(...)` calls) and <issue id="9ce2b7c9-29f5-4e6d-8998-49e2cc4af859" label="DRG-323" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-323/gitnexus-mcp-servers-return-corrupted-results-after-the-2026-09-27" /> (MCP corruption).

## Acceptance criteria

* Tune entry-point ranking and the depth/branching/budget limits (or the config) so the key runtime entry points (`DelegationBridgeHost.RunTick`, `SimplePlayModeSimHost.Update`, the CLI commands) produce flows.
* Re-run the <issue id="72627172-94af-41de-b160-61e0febb7890" label="DRG-197" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-197/reindex-gitnexus-and-verify-the-post-implementation-knowledge-graph" /> sample impact checks and show processes for projections that have known runtime callers.

## Problem

`SkillEnvelopeValidator.Validate(SkillEnvelope, bool proposalApproved)` is public and tested, but no production code calls it. Production code reuses only its reason-code constants. Either the skill-envelope check is never enforced at runtime, or the method is dead code.

## Evidence

* `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Skills/SkillEnvelopeValidator.cs` (L31, `Validate`).
* GitHub code search for `SkillEnvelopeValidator` on main finds only tests (`src/ProjectAegis.Delegation.Tests/Skills/SkillEnvelopeValidatorTests.cs`), docs/contract files (`production/docs/skills/agent-c2-skill-contract/*`, `docs/engineering/c2-authority-escalation-chrome.md`), and `src/ProjectAegis.Delegation/Skills/C2AuthorityProjector.cs`. `C2AuthorityProjector` references only the `Reason*` constants (L15–17) and never calls `Validate`.

## Acceptance criteria

* Make a decision, written down: either wire `Validate` into the production skill/engage command path, or remove it and move the constants somewhere else.

issues.title: Per-category message-log notification policy (log / pause / map balloon / drop to 1x)
issues.description:
Source: `Game-Requirements/requirements/17-Replay-AAR-And-Order-Log.md` (106; +3 below)
Req IDs: RPL-15, OPS-01, PRD-P1-2, UI-08
Lifecycle: Active; Draft (pending owner)
Notion: [https://www.notion.so/421f7cb4e4df8197a0ebe97257bbe142](<https://www.notion.so/421f7cb4e4df8197a0ebe97257bbe142>)
Acceptance Criteria:

- [ ] MessageCategoryPolicy maps categories to Log/Pause/Balloon/1x via facade.

---

Wiki: [https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc>)

Additional Sources:

* Source: `notion://3f2f7cb4e4df8199aad8f1dd50c6831e` (Milsim Comparative Research & New Requirements — 2026-10-07, 66)
* Source: `docs/product/prd-mvp-ui-2026-07-15.md` (96)
* Source: `docs/product/ui-requirements-brainstorm-2026-07-15.md` (47-55)

## Problem

The message log has no per-category notification policy. In CMO, each message type (new contact, weapon launch, weapon endgame, unit lost, fuel, etc.) can be set to: show in the log, raise a pop-up that pauses the sim, show a balloon on the map at the subject, and drop time compression to 1x. Without this, a player running at high time compression can miss a hostile launch or a lost unit until well after it happens. Aegis has pause and acceleration (<issue id="33bfdfcc-aeed-49b3-b9a5-e2dd6df86193" label="DRG-14" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-14/implement-sim-clock-time-acceleration-and-pause" />) and a message log (<issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" />, <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" />), but nothing links log categories to attention or time-control behavior.

## Evidence/Research

* CMO manual, Game Options → Message Log: per message type, "Show on Message Log", "Raise Pop-Up" (pauses the game), "Show Balloon" (on the map at the subject's location), and "Timescale X1" (drop from acceleration to 1x). [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-9-drop-down-menus/>)
* CMO manual §3.1.7: the log is split into categories that can be minimized or emphasized, so routine messages don't bury critical ones. Hovering a message highlights its subject on the map. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/>)
* Player feedback asks for exactly this per-type control, including keeping time running while still being notified. [https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/](<https://steamcommunity.com/app/1076160/discussions/0/2573194192006749192/>)
* Existing backlog: <issue id="1a498761-2ae0-4eec-b4ef-ac1a72a91cca" label="DRG-268" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-268/c2-13-message-log-click-unit-explain-deep-link" /> covers click → unit deep-link, and <issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" /> covers sourcing combat lines from CombatEvent. Neither covers category policy or time-control escalation.

## Acceptance criteria

* A headless `MessageCategoryPolicy` projection maps each message category to {Log, Pause, Balloon, DropToRealTime}. Defaults are data-driven, not hardcoded.
* When a matching message arrives, the projection emits an attention intent. Pause and 1x requests go through the existing command/time façade as player-visible requests. The projection never calls sim internals directly, and the change does not touch the DelegationBridge Tick/hotpath or SimulationSession.
* The UI binds only to the projection. A settings panel edits the policy, and balloon markers anchor to the message subject.
* Replay is deterministic: under AttachReplayViewer, policy-driven pauses are suppressed or reported but never change the order log.
* Tests cover the default mapping, a user override, and the no-op under replay.

Origin: Projects Manager web research 2026-10-07

Scoping: CMANO adds Surface before Todo

issues.description:
## Problem

Authority and ROE state is projected (<issue id="09fd8608-86ec-4243-888d-7dd0f126a8d2" label="DRG-182" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-182/project-command-authority-and-rules-of-engagement-state" />, <issue id="62f19a5c-38c2-44cb-ad50-c2e2ba23b291" label="DRG-209" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-209/slice-a-headless-authority-and-roe-projection" />), and WRA salvo-remaining shows on weapon chrome (<issue id="b052e2f4-59ae-43a4-850f-ae28460de62f" label="DRG-259" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-259/c2-02-wra-salvo-remaining-on-weapon-chrome" />). But the player cannot see *where* a unit's effective doctrine, ROE, or WRA value comes from (side, mission, group, or unit override), or reset an override back to inherited. In CMO this inheritance view is the main way a player finds out why a unit held fire or fired unexpectedly.

## Evidence/Research

* CMO manual §3.3.12: every doctrine option has an "inherited" setting. A unit follows its side's doctrine, or its mission's doctrine if assigned to one, and buttons reset it to the inherited default. Doctrine, EMCON, and WRA are separate tabs. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/>)
* CMO manual §6.3.8: side doctrine/ROE/WRA is set at the top level and "flows down to mission and then groups/units". The WRA tab lists every weapon the side uses. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/drop-down-menus/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/drop-down-menus/>)
* Existing backlog: <issue id="9cb22a1c-4d7a-499d-ba6d-44462898cedd" label="DRG-321" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-321/jev-vs3-roe-noul-facade-accept-coordinationcommandbridge" /> (ROE Noul + façade Accept) is about AI-assisted ROE suggestions, not showing inheritance. No issue covers per-level provenance or reset.

## Acceptance criteria

* A headless `DoctrineInheritanceProjection` gives, for each selected unit and each doctrine/ROE/WRA field: the effective value, the source level (Side/Mission/Group/Unit), and the overridden parent value if there is one.
* Reset-to-inherited is sent as a command through the command façade and recorded in the order log. It is never a UI-side state mutation.
* The unit panel shows an override marker and a source badge for each field, and the WRA rows show target-type × quantity × range using the existing <issue id="b052e2f4-59ae-43a4-850f-ae28460de62f" label="DRG-259" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-259/c2-02-wra-salvo-remaining-on-weapon-chrome" /> chrome.
* The engagement explanation (<issue id="4d622922-9423-4af4-aa9b-1aff30bf0146" label="DRG-168" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-168/build-engagement-explanation-surface" />) can cite the doctrine source level when doctrine is the refusal reason.
* Tests cover inherited, mission-overridden, and unit-overridden fields, and the reset round-trip under replay.

issues.description:
## Problem

The attack-options menu (<issue id="edefdae9-4a5b-49dc-ba94-cc0d4a461203" label="DRG-262" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-262/c2-05-attack-options-menu-preview-parity" />) previews one shooter against one target. There is no way to build a manual allocation plan across several selected targets and shooters: N weapons per target, with a per-weapon "OK, can fire" or a specific reason it can't. CMO's manual allocation dialog (Shift+F1) is the main player tool for coordinated strikes and for learning weapon limits.

## Evidence/Research

* CMO manual §3 (Engage Target(s) Manual): drag-select multiple targets, pick an attacker, and see suitable weapons grouped by type. Legal weapons that are outside firing parameters show the reason in red; valid ones show "OK - Can fire". You allocate a quantity per target, and allocations show both per attacker and per target. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/>) and [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-3-shortcut-buttons-and-windows/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/05-3-shortcut-buttons-and-windows/>)
* CMO combat chapter: manual assignment is "a very effective method of getting good feedback on weaponry limitations", because the crew runs an exhaustive checklist of conditions. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/combat/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/combat/>)
* Existing backlog: <issue id="edefdae9-4a5b-49dc-ba94-cc0d4a461203" label="DRG-262" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-262/c2-05-attack-options-menu-preview-parity" /> is single-target preview parity, <issue id="077bcad5-8b44-4c82-9f04-cdcff7dfa3df" label="DRG-265" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-265/c2-14-domain-abort-codes-in-engage-explain-chrome" /> covers abort codes in the engage explanation, <issue id="0f26c476-2643-4cb9-b689-d068770f58bd" label="DRG-172" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-172/add-threat-assessment-and-weapon-recommendation" /> covers recommendations, and <issue id="8d85d519-5cec-4c0a-a35a-63206eb9d6cc" label="DRG-224" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-224/slice-b-headless-magazine-and-salvo-employment-ledger" /> is the employment ledger. None covers a multi-target allocation plan.

## Acceptance criteria

* A headless `AllocationPlanProjection` takes {shooters\[\], targets\[\], allocations\[\]} and returns, for each (shooter, weapon, target): Can-fire, or a domain `FireAbortReason` code reused from <issue id="077bcad5-8b44-4c82-9f04-cdcff7dfa3df" label="DRG-265" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-265/c2-14-domain-abort-codes-in-engage-explain-chrome" />. It also returns per-target and per-shooter totals and the remaining magazine count from the <issue id="8d85d519-5cec-4c0a-a35a-63206eb9d6cc" label="DRG-224" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-224/slice-b-headless-magazine-and-salvo-employment-ledger" /> ledger.
* Committing a plan sends ordinary engage commands through the command façade. The projection itself never fires and does not touch the DelegationBridge Tick/hotpath.
* The UI lists allocations by attacker and by target. Reasons use the same text source as <issue id="4d622922-9423-4af4-aa9b-1aff30bf0146" label="DRG-168" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-168/build-engagement-explanation-surface" />/<issue id="077bcad5-8b44-4c82-9f04-cdcff7dfa3df" label="DRG-265" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-265/c2-14-domain-abort-codes-in-engage-explain-chrome" />.
* Over-allocation beyond the magazine is rejected with a reason before commit.
* Tests cover a 2×3 plan, a mixed can-fire/abort result, an over-allocation reject, and replay determinism of the committed orders.

issues.description:
## Problem

The engagement explanation (<issue id="4d622922-9423-4af4-aa9b-1aff30bf0146" label="DRG-168" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-168/build-engagement-explanation-surface" />) and contact provenance (<issue id="fc4092be-a4ee-4268-8ecb-27f647c14bf2" label="DRG-180" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-180/surface-contact-provenance-confidence-freshness-and-comms-state" />) show contact confidence, but not *positional* ambiguity relative to what a given weapon can tolerate. In CMO a frequent cause of "why won't it fire?" is that the contact's area of uncertainty is larger than the weapon's downrange or cross-range tolerance, scaled by an ambiguity doctrine (Ignore / Optimistic / Pessimistic). Players need to see that on the map and in the refusal text.

## Evidence/Research

* CMO manual: an ambiguous contact is one with an uncertainty area. With doctrine set to "Optimistic", the uncertainty must be under 3× the weapon tolerance before launch; with "Pessimistic", under 1×. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/>)
* CMO combat chapter: the refusal reads "target's downrange ambiguity (X nm) is larger than … the weapon's acceptable limit (Y nm)", e.g. a ±10 nm contact against a 2 nm weapon limit. [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/combat/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/combat/>)
* Existing backlog: <issue id="421c7902-2fda-47b4-8329-0603014f8fd7" label="DRG-385" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-385/asw-05-passive-bearing-only-tracking" /> (passive bearing-only tracking) adds uncertainty on the sim side. No presentation issue compares uncertainty with weapon tolerance.

## Acceptance criteria

* The headless explanation DTO adds, for each (weapon, contact): downrange and cross-range ambiguity, the weapon tolerance, the active ambiguity doctrine level, and pass/fail. All of it is read from existing contact and weapon data, with no new sim truth.
* The refusal text uses the CMO-style numbers ("ambiguity X nm > limit Y nm"), and the wording shares one source with <issue id="4d622922-9423-4af4-aa9b-1aff30bf0146" label="DRG-168" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-168/build-engagement-explanation-surface" />/<issue id="077bcad5-8b44-4c82-9f04-cdcff7dfa3df" label="DRG-265" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-265/c2-14-domain-abort-codes-in-engage-explain-chrome" />.
* The map draws the contact's area-of-uncertainty ellipse from the projection, and hiding it is a declutter option (<issue id="c8b79a30-0b7e-4f3f-a4b0-0b22320a67b1" label="DRG-176" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-176/set-combat-picture-performance-and-declutter-budgets" /> budget).
* Tests cover a contact inside tolerance, inside 3× (Optimistic passes, Pessimistic fails), and outside, all with replay-stable output.

Source: Projects Manager web research 2026-10-07

Scoping: CMANO adds Surface before Todo

## Definition of Ready (Hygiene, 2026-10-29)

Verified at `main` [`3bcfbb7b`](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/3bcfbb7bede990c6d855b56f5f32b89329334ee2>). Status unchanged (Backlog). Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO.

* **Links:** explanation [DRG-168](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-168>), provenance [DRG-180](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-180>), abort wording [DRG-265](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-265>), passive tracking [DRG-385](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-385>), declutter [DRG-176](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-176>).
* **Dependencies:** the ellipse declutter toggle references the <issue id="c8b79a30-0b7e-4f3f-a4b0-0b22320a67b1" label="DRG-176" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-176/set-combat-picture-performance-and-declutter-budgets" /> budget, which is not yet defined; the headless DTO and refusal text do not depend on it.
* **Fences (from rubric H3/H5):** headless projection first; source-fence test (no UnityEngine/MonoBehaviour/ApplyOrder/DecisionLog write/SimulationSession/DelegationBridge refs); replay hash `17144800277401907079` unchanged, no ReplayGolden re-bless; any visible UI change gets a named [DRG-208](<https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-208>) Play Mode walk item (human gate).

## Approved recommendation follow-through — 2026-10-30

User instruction: “proceed with your recommendations” following the game-mechanics/UX review. [Delivery plan](<https://app.notion.com/p/409f7cb4e4df815bbccfe465326584cc?pvs=204>). Baseline main 570a7f843ebffaa0ec9f2a3d9a7871d0354adc51. Product direction is authorized; no runtime delivery, passing tests, current-head owner acceptance, or protected-method waiver is asserted.

Source-contract prerequisite discovered during follow-through: ContactProvenanceState at main 570a7f84 has identification confidence, freshness/age and comms flags, but no downrange/cross-range ambiguity or weapon tolerance. This establishes a gap in that DTO, not proof that no other domain provider exists.

Before numeric UI work:

* Identify authoritative producer fields, units, unknown representation and observation time for both contact uncertainty and weapon tolerance.
* If absent, scope a Sim-owned capability/provider dependency; never manufacture values in presentation.
* Reconcile ambiguity doctrine/multipliers with Aegis's actual resolver. Reference-product 1x/3x examples are not an implemented Aegis contract.

issues.description:
## Problem

The after-action ledger (<issue id="9b776f75-8294-4519-9e52-85f656fd4a3a" label="DRG-218" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-218/slice-c-headless-after-action-ledger" />) and the timeline (<issue id="8741c4c5-8d30-4157-a995-0818ca5171d1" label="DRG-171" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-171/add-combat-timeline-and-after-action-review" />) exist, but there is no plain chronological text view of the message log and no export file for after-action analysis or bug reports. CMO offers an interactive categorized view, a raw-text view, and "print to file" (AALog.txt). Aegis testers and players need a deterministic text artifact they can diff between replays.

## Evidence/Research

* CMO manual §3.1.7: in a separate window, the message log toggles between the interactive categorized view and a "raw text" view (detailed messages in chronological order). [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/user-interface/>)
* CMO manual §6.3.11: Message Log → "print to file" writes AALog.Txt "for after action analysis of the game mechanics". [https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/drop-down-menus/](<https://command.matrixgames.com/manual/drop-down-menus/>)
* Existing backlog: <issue id="8741c4c5-8d30-4157-a995-0818ca5171d1" label="DRG-171" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-171/add-combat-timeline-and-after-action-review" /> (timeline/AAR UI) and <issue id="9b776f75-8294-4519-9e52-85f656fd4a3a" label="DRG-218" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-218/slice-c-headless-after-action-ledger" /> (headless AAR ledger) do not cover a text export or a raw view. <issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" /> changes the source of the combat lines.

## Acceptance criteria

* A headless `MessageLogTextExport` renders the projected log (after <issue id="082c1311-1fd2-4dcf-bef4-ac6765044ab9" label="DRG-402" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-402/source-messagelogprojection-combat-lines-from-the-combatevent-contract" />, combat lines come from CombatEvent) as stable plain text: sim time, category, subject id, message.
* Two replays of the same (scenario, seed) produce byte-identical exports, checked by a golden test.
* The UI toggles between the categorized and raw views and has an export action that writes to a user path. Export is read-only and never mutates sim state.
* The export works under AttachReplayViewer.

issues.description:
Follow-up deferred from [PR #713](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/pull/713>) (merged `3f5ae73f`; DRG-379/386/390), listed under "Follow-ups (not in this PR)".

`CatalogSensorBinding.RadarScanType`, `FrequencyAgile` and `RadarTechGeneration` are read and validated from catalog JSON (`CatalogRadarScanTypes.Validate`). But `CatalogJsonImporter.WriteSqlite`'s `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sensor` doesn't write them, and `SqliteCatalogReader` returns the defaults (empty / false / 0). So a SQLite-backed catalog gets no ECCM jam adjustment.

## Scope

* New extend-only migration under `assets/data/catalog/migrations` adding `radar_scan_type`, `frequency_agile`, `radar_tech_generation` to `sensor` (and to `sensor_quarantine` if quarantine rows round-trip).
* `CatalogJsonImporter` (sensor and quarantine inserts) writes the columns; `SqliteCatalogReader` maps them.
* Round-trip test: JSON → SQLite → reader equals the JSON reader result and passes `CatalogRadarScanTypes.Validate`.

## Constraints

* `CatalogWriteGate` **writes are hard-no.** `InsertStagingSensor` / `catalog_staging_sensor` and `CatalogQuarantinePromoter.InsertSensor` don't carry these columns. Extending the staged write path is out of scope and needs a CMANO Surface stamp plus owner GO as a separate item.
* Check whether `CatalogSnapshotHasher` output changes. Replay hash `17144800277401907079` unchanged; no ReplayGolden re-bless.

`CommsGridRegistry.ReportPosition(unitId, simTick, lat, lon)` exists and freezes reports while a unit is off grid, but only tests call it (`CommsGridRegistryTests`, `OffGridCommandFacadeTests`). issues.description:

The GitNexus registry entry `cmano-clone` points at `/workspace/cmano-clone`. Its index is stale: commit `1e627c72`, indexed 10/7, 42,441 nodes. That checkout sits on branch `docs/adr-028-029-accepted` and holds six untracked generated `.claude/skills/gitnexus-*` folders. The gitnexus MCP resolves repos through the registry with no `-r` and no path, so it can serve this stale index.

A dedicated clean index now exists at `/workspace/gitnexus-index` (registry name `gitnexus-index`, main at d6fd56b3, 0 garbage IDs).

Open items, none started:

* Point the harness `user-gitnexus` MCP default at `-r gitnexus-index`.
* Decide what to do with the stale `cmano-clone` registry entry. Removing it would delete the shared checkout's `.gitnexus`.
* Clean up or move the shared checkout.
* Until then, blast-radius checks stay on `rg`.

No `Surface:` line. Tooling only.

## Definition of Ready (Hygiene, 2026-10-29)

Verified at `main` [`3bcfbb7b`](<https://github.com/drgaciw/cmano-clone/commit/3bcfbb7bede990c6d855b56f5f32b89329334ee2>). Status unchanged (Backlog). Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO.

attachments.subtitle: A collaborative AI workspace, built on your company context. Build and orchestrate agents right alongside your team's projects, meetings, and connected apps.

issues.description:
## Context

.NET 11 went GA on 2026-11-10. `main` at `2ddbd393` targets `net10.0` in all 16 projects, with SDK pin `10.0.403` and `rollForward: latestMajor`. .NET 11 (STS) and .NET 10 (LTS) both leave support in November 2028, so moving costs no support time.

This follows the pattern of <issue id="8b56b601-b984-4543-8a2f-834222bdd3d6" label="DRG-669" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-669/upgrade-cmano-clone-from-net-8-to-net-10-before-net-8-end-of-support" /> (.NET 8 to 10), but ships as three PRs so a replay or test difference can be attributed to the compiler, the runtime, or the inspection tooling.

## Scope

* PR 1: SDK pin and every hard-coded tooling pin. Projects stay on `net10.0`.
* PR 2: retarget all 16 projects to `net11.0`. The four Unity-facing projects keep `netstandard2.1`.
* PR 3: ReSharper CLI validation, inspection baseline, live documentation, ADR-022.

Unchanged: C# `LangVersion` 12.0, the 10.0.14 package pins used by the `netstandard2.1` targets, Unity Editor and package pins. Runtime Async stays off.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Full gate script green after each PR: 0 failures, at least 1,638 passes, test count not below the captured baseline.
2. ReplayGolden 6/6. Baltic v2 hash `17144800277401907079` unchanged. No golden re-bless. v3 goldens untouched.
3. PlayModeSmokeHarness at least 20 passes. Staged Unity plug-in DLL list equals baseline.
4. Build warning count not above baseline, or each new warning fixed or justified individually.
5. `git grep` for `10.0.403` and `net10.0` returns only dated history.
6. PR 2 reverts cleanly on its own.

## Parallel tracks

Tracks A (baseline), B (SDK pins), C (ReSharper wrapper), and D (compatibility fixtures) touch disjoint files and can run at the same time. Track E (docs) follows PR 2. A coordinator owns `global.json`, `renovate.json`, and the csproj edits.

## Gate for other work

The exit of PR 2 is gate **G0** for the AI feature integration epic. AI Wave 0 does not wait for it.

Plan: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-12-dotnet-11-upgrade.md` (revision 2, not yet on `main`). Status stays Backlog. Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO before Todo.

attachments.title: Notion: .NET 11 upgrade and AI integration — delivery plan and parallel dispatch
attachments.subtitle: A collaborative AI workspace, built on your company context. Build and orchestrate agents right alongside your team's projects, meetings, and connected apps.

issues.description:
## Context

Add model-backed assistance outside simulation ticks: an after-action assistant that cites evidence, structured mission authoring on the proposal lane, and a measured retrieval pilot. Accepted authoring changes go through the existing validation and write-gate workflows. Nothing model-generated reaches the `Submit` lane without a human.

The repository already has deterministic stubs for part of this (`AiAuthoringServices`, `scenario_ai_scaffold`, `ProvenanceTag`, `SkillLane.Propose`). This epic extends those seams. It does not add parallel ones.

## Structure

AI code lives in new assemblies so that AI packages cannot reach the four `netstandard2.1` shared projects or the Unity plug-in folder:

* `ProjectAegis.Ai.Contracts` (`netstandard2.1;net11.0`, no package references)
* `ProjectAegis.Ai.Host` (`net11.0`)
* `ProjectAegis.Ai.Host.Tests` (in the solution and the CI gate, fake provider only)
* `ProjectAegis.Ai.LiveEval` (outside the solution, run on demand)

## Delivery order

1. **Wave 0** — contracts, host skeleton with fake client, fixtures, architecture gates and ADR-030. Four parallel tracks. Does not need the .NET 11 upgrade.
2. **Slice 1** — evidence export. The JSONL writer needs gate G0 (upgrade PR 2).
3. **Slices 2, 3, 4 in parallel** — AAR assistant, mission authoring (blocked on the ADR-015 decision), retrieval pilot (decision gate).
4. **Slice 5** — optional explanation UI and experiment reports, after slices 2 and 3 ship.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Replay fingerprints match with AI enabled, disabled, delayed, or failing. No AI call in tick paths.
2. CI needs no credentials. Live evaluations never gate CI.
3. Every citation resolves to exported evidence. No fabricated IDs. No number in prose contradicts the source report.
4. Evidence is filtered to the viewing side before prompt construction.
5. No AI package or DLL in the shared projects or `Assets/Plugins/ProjectAegis`, enforced by a test.
6. Nothing derived from Track A of the dual-track firewall is sent to a provider, enforced by a test.

## Rules for every sub-issue

* New directories only. `ProjectAegis.sln`, `Program.cs`, `mcp-tools.json`, `renovate.json`, and `AGENTS.md` are edited only by the coordinator's integration issue for each wave.
* `LangVersion` 12.0. No edits to `DelegationBridge`. `CatalogWriteGate` is extend-only. No ReplayGolden re-bless. No `*.[db3-redacted]`.

Plan: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-12-dotnet-11-ai-feature-integration.md` (revision 2, not yet on `main`). Status stays Backlog. Scoping and Surface stay with CMANO before Todo.

issues.title: [NET11-D] Compatibility fixtures: corrupt-CRC scenario package test and net10/net11 replay comparison

attachments.title: Notion task: DRG-726 compatibility fixtures
attachments.subtitle: A collaborative AI workspace, built on your company context. Build and orchestrate agents right alongside your team's projects, meetings, and connected apps.

issues.description:
## Problem

Two .NET 11 behaviour changes touch code this repository depends on, and neither has a test today.

* ZIP: CRC32 is now validated on read, and async open loads entries eagerly. `AegisScenarioPackage` uses `ZipFile.OpenAsync` and `OpenReadAsync`, so a corrupt package now fails at open instead of at entry read.
* Runtime numerics: `Math.Round(value, digits)` is now correctly rounded, and unchecked float-to-small-integer casts saturate. Replay determinism needs direct proof.

## Scope

1. Add one corrupt-CRC scenario package fixture and a test that asserts the failure is reported cleanly through both the sync and async paths. The test must pass on `net10.0` and `net11.0`.
2. Run the replay comparison experiment: with SDK 11 installed, temporarily multi-target the replay test project to `net10.0;net11.0` on a throwaway branch and compare fingerprints from one commit on one machine. Report the result. Do not merge the multi-target change.
3. Confirm by analyzer or search that Sim, Delegation, and Data contain no unchecked float-to-`byte`/`short`/`char` casts. A pattern search found none.

New test files only. Can start now.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Corrupt-package test green on the current target.
2. Replay comparison result posted here: fingerprints equal, or the first differing tick identified.
3. Cast audit result posted here.
4. Baltic v2 hash `17144800277401907079` unchanged. No golden re-bless.

Scoping: CMANO adds Surface before Todo.

Proposed surface (not a CMANO stamp): new fixture and test under `src/ProjectAegis.Data.Tests/Scenario/`. Read-only: `src/ProjectAegis.Data/Scenario/Authoring/AegisScenarioPackage.cs`, `AegisScenarioPackage.Async.cs`.

`Math.Round(value, digits)` call sites outside tick paths: `src/ProjectAegis.Data/Validation/Rules/ValidationRules.cs` (lines near 286 and 356), `src/ProjectAegis.Data/PlatformAssistant/PlatformRelativeScaler.cs`. Check that their existing tests cover a midpoint value.

## Status: Accepted (2026-11-16)

**Chosen: B Balanced** — ΔRecall@5 ≥ +0.10; CitationPrecision@5 ≥ 0.85; k=5 vs keyword. Fail-either → stop Slice 4 vectors. Query count recorded with results; if < \~40 queries, pass is provisional pending a larger set before vector commit.

Accepted under owner/Technical Director drg amtd's delegation to Decision bot (5:47 AM CT). `hold:owner-go` cleared.

---

## Decision needed

The retrieval pilot compares the existing catalog and keyword lookup with an embedding approach on the same query set. Vector storage is added only if the pilot wins by a margin.

Set that margin **before** the pilot runs, so the result cannot shape the bar:

* Minimum improvement in recall at a fixed result count.
* Minimum citation precision.

## Why it blocks

The slice 4 retrieval pilot. If the pilot misses the margin, slice 4 stops and keyword lookup stays.

## Done when

Both numbers are recorded here.

issues.description:
## Problem

A model-written after-action summary is only useful if every claim can be traced to evidence and no number is invented.

## Scope

In `Ai.Host`, a pipeline that takes exported evidence and returns a structured result: summary, outcomes, uncertainties, citations.

* The host copies quantitative values from the source report. The model supplies prose and evidence IDs only.
* Evidence text is delimited as data and never concatenated into instructions.
* Validation before publication: reject if any cited ID is absent from the evidence (`RejectedCitation`) or any number in prose disagrees with the report (`RejectedNumber`).
* Timeout, cancellation, malformed output, and unavailable provider each return their explicit status **plus the existing deterministic report**.
* The result is published as an artifact with the full envelope.

Runs entirely on `FakeChatClient` in CI.

## Acceptance criteria

1. All citations resolve on every fixture. Zero fabricated IDs. Zero contradictory numbers.
2. A scripted fake response with a fabricated ID is rejected. Same for a wrong number.
3. Every failure fixture returns its explicit status and the deterministic report.
4. The embedded-instruction fixture does not change behaviour.
5. Replay fingerprints match with the pipeline enabled, disabled, delayed, or failing.
6. No network access in tests.

## Dependencies

**Companion files:** `cmano-arch-audit-2026-11-16-10sprint-evidence.md` (PR lists per window, scanner change log), `cmano-arch-audit-2026-11-16-10sprint-issues.md` (Linear issues per window)
**Exclusions (per instruction):** `SimulationSession`, `DelegationBridge` and `CatalogWriteGate` were left completely alone. Their files are excluded from every scan and from the namespace graph, and nothing in this report flags them for change.

## 1. Scores

Scale: Decision's 1–5 (5 = compliant), with a Compliant / Minor drift / Significant drift label. **All scores below are proposals from this lane; Decision (Jev router) has not scored any cmano-clone window.** They are not copied from open-crm-cpq. Findings are scored only against ADRs accepted on or before the commit date; earlier changes are **pre-ADR baseline items**, not drift.

Architecture positive: 7 architecture/honesty test files landed (`NoDynamicExecutionGateTests`, `DerivedOnlyInvariantTests`, Wave 3/4 pins), ADR-013–017 filed. No boundary breaks |

| S3 | Jul 27–Aug 9 | informational only | normal | 97 (all PRs; 3 rebase-merged: <pull-request id="7a3ee5f3-9989-4899-9581-482804aa779b" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#349" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/builddeps-bump-the-npm-and-yarn-group-across-1-directory-with-6-a33f17a61103" />, <pull-request id="99984af1-1361-4e58-a266-f3d249e79527" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#403" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/cigauntlet-run-toolsqa-gauntlet-pytest-on-pr-drg-59-2966cfd617bd" />, <pull-request id="28e94b3c-098f-4dda-8f98-4f98cc11f48c" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#404" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/fixgauntlet-regenerate-coverage-map-counts-drift-guard-drg-60-8c33f8147ec2" />) | Compliant | 4.5 (info) | Sim namespace cycle grows: `Swarm` (<pull-request id="ac36ff2f-1a67-45da-952d-5c2d2706f116" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#415" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/featsim-swarm-a3-engagement-scaling-hard-counter-aa-drg-88-096394208e42" />) and `Swarm.Expend` (<pull-request id="b066d133-b9b4-4fb7-a1b5-f05a97ede65c" label="drgaciw/cmano-clone#434" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/review/featsim-swarm-c4-expendkamikaze-pulse-drg-108-3ed8bc671d94" />) join the existing Sim SCC. No ADR prohibits namespace cycles, so recorded as structural debt only |

ADR-027 is recorded (#679, Oct 1) four days after its stated acceptance and after the code it governs (#618) |

ADR-028/029 filed Proposed (#706/#707, Oct 7) and accepted Oct 15 (#723); no new H5/H6 implementation landed in between (good ordering). Addressables use itself predates ADR-028 (`321b0be0` Jun 18; Editor asmdef ref via #238 Jul 13): pre-ADR baseline. #719 creates a new 4-namespace Delegation cycle (`CombatEvents`/`Projection`/`SensorToShooter`/`TargetabilityAccept`) |
| S9 | Oct 19–Nov 1 | **in scope** | normal | 32 PRs | Minor drift | **4.0** | #770 (Oct 29) retargets every headless project net8.0→net10.0 while ADR-022's Engine row still said ".NET 8" (fixed only Nov 14 in #846) and ADR-006 §Engine still says net8.0 today: code ahead of ADR. #799 SQLite migration stays inside Data (ADR-006 compliant) |
| S10 | Nov 2–15 | **in scope** | normal | 38 PRs | Minor drift | **3.5** | AI wave lands the same day ADR-030 is accepted: #849 `Ai.Contracts` merged 13:24, ADR-030 + gates #853 13:40, `Ai.Host` #854 13:48 (Contracts-before-Host is allowed by ADR-030). **#860 adds a ProjectReference from** `MissionEditor.Cli` **to** `Ai.Host`, pulling [Microsoft.Extensions.AI](<http://Microsoft.Extensions.AI>) into the authoring CLI, which ADR-030's rejected-alternatives table argues against ("couples provider SDKs and credentials to the authoring CLI … prefer thin CLI verbs calling a separate [Ai.Host](<http://Ai.Host>)"). ADR-015 flipped Proposed→Accepted inside feature PR #863. ADR-030 (Accepted) depends on ADR-013's firewall, and ADR-013 is still Proposed. #812 adds `ThreatAssessment` to the Delegation cycle. Positive: .NET 11 retarget #845 and ADR-022 amendment #846 merged 49 s apart; `AiHostBoundaryGateTests` and `LiveEvalIsolationGateTests` added |

**Overall (in-scope, S5–S10): 4.08 / 5** (mean of 4.5, 4.5, 4.0, 4.0, 4.0, 3.5). All proposed.
**All-10 average (informational):** 4.15 (adds S1–S4 informational 3.0, 4.5, 4.5, 5.0).
**Trend:** slow, steady decline from 4.5 (S5–S6) to 3.5 (S10). Hard boundaries held in every window: no `UnityEngine` in Data/Sim/Delegation, no SQLite outside Data, no network on the Sim/Delegation tick path, no AI packages on Unity-bound projects, and the csproj graph matches ADR-001/006/010/030 throughout. The drift is in three softer places: (1) intra-assembly namespace cycles grow (Delegation 10→15 namespaces in cycles across S8–S10, UnityAdapter new in S7); (2) ADR governance (ADRs recorded after acceptance or after the code, acceptance flipped inside feature PRs, an Accepted ADR depending on a Proposed one); (3) docs falling behind (architecture.md ADR index, ADR-006 TFM). Governance of main improved sharply after S1: from S2 on, every unit on main came through a PR.

## 2. Hard-boundary checks (every first-parent commit, S1 baseline to HEAD)

| Check | ADR | Result S1–S10 |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Sim references only Data; Delegation only Data + Sim; Data references nothing | ADR-001, ADR-006 | Held in all 579 commits |
| No `using UnityEngine/UnityEditor` in Data, Sim, Delegation | ADR-010, Layer rule 1 | 0 hits |
| No SQLite in Sim or Delegation | ADR-006 | 0 hits |
| No `HttpClient`/sockets in Sim/Delegation outside `Delegation/Hindsight/` | ADR-030 (accepted Nov 15; earlier = baseline) | 0 hits. Hindsight has 3 (documented exception) |
| No wall clock (`DateTime.Now/UtcNow`) in Sim/Delegation | Layer rule 3 | 0 hits |
| No `Process.Start`/`Process.Run*` on authoring/validation path | ADR-014, ADR-030 | 0 hits |
| No `Microsoft.Extensions.AI` outside Ai.\*; `Ai.Contracts` zero PackageReference | ADR-030 | Held |
| GitNexus cross-check (index `cmano-clone-932f88b5`, Nov 16) | ADR-001 | Sim→Delegation/AI import edges: 3, all README links, no code |

## 3. Current-state structural scan of main (`7eed6791`; HEAD `8b4fd3ec` identical except where noted)

| Check | Result |
| -- | -- |
| Project graph | Ai.Contracts → none; [Ai.Host](<http://Ai.Host>) → Ai.Contracts, Data, Delegation; Ai.LiveEval → Ai.Contracts, [Ai.Host](<http://Ai.Host>); Data → none; Data.Excel → Data; Sim → Data; Delegation → Data, Sim; UnityAdapter → Data, Delegation (+ Ai.Contracts at HEAD via #869, allowed by ADR-030); MissionEditor.Cli → [Ai.Host](<http://Ai.Host>), Data, Data.Excel, UnityAdapter (**[Ai.Host](<http://Ai.Host>) edge: see §8 item 1**) |
| Unity asmdefs | Runtime: no asmdef refs, consumes precompiled plug-ins; Cesium → Runtime + CesiumForUnity; Editor (Editor-only) → Runtime + Addressables; Tests → Runtime + TestRunner. Plug-ins folder holds Data, Sim, Delegation, UnityAdapter, Ai.Contracts and SQLite DLLs; no AI provider DLLs |
| Unity scripts importing Sim types directly | 3 of 56: `MapPlaceholderPanelHost.cs` (pre-S1 baseline), `C2TopBarPanelHost.cs` (#669, S7), and one bridge host file that is excluded per instruction |
| Namespace cycles (structural debt; no ADR forbids them) | Data: 1 SCC of 11 (`Agents`, `Catalog`, `Osint`, `Platform`, `Scenario`, `Scenario.Authoring`, `Scenario.Policy`, `Snapshots`, `Validation`, `Validation.Rules`, `WriteGate`), unchanged since baseline. Sim: 1 SCC of 8 (baseline 6 + `Swarm`, `Swarm.Expend` in S3). Delegation: 3 SCCs, 15 namespaces (`Attention`/`Comms`/`Decision`/`Hindsight`/`Sim`/`Trust`; `Controllers`/`Groups`/`Orchestration`/`Targets`; `CombatEvents`/`Projection`/`SensorToShooter`/`TargetabilityAccept`/`ThreatAssessment`, the last SCC new in S8–S10). UnityAdapter: `CommandReview`↔`Presentation` (S7). Ai.\*, Data.Excel, MissionEditor.Cli: none |
| ADR-006 temporary exception | `src/ProjectAegis.Sim/Scenario/ScenarioPolicyRepository.cs` still in Sim (exception "until DATA-3", open since June) |
| Architecture tests | 9 files: `AiHostBoundaryGateTests` (packages, Plugins DLLs, process helpers, Sim/Delegation network), `NoDynamicExecutionGateTests`, `DerivedOnlyInvariantTests`, requirements-hub/honesty pins, `LiveEvalIsolationGateTests`. **No test pins the csproj reference graph (ADR-001/006/010) or namespace cycles**; today these hold only by convention and review |
| Docs/ADR sync | `docs/architecture/architecture.md` (last changed Sep 4) ADR index lists ADR-001–010 only; 21 more ADRs exist (011, 0012, 013–030, the SimulationSession addendum, S41-03). `architecture-traceability-index.md` covers 001–013, 018–022, 030 but not 014–017, 023–029. ADR-006 still says net8.0. Proposed today: ADR-013, 023, 024, 025, 026 |
| Secrets | None searched for in the repo (out of lane). Box note: a credential is embedded in the push URL of the shared box clone `/workspace/cmano-clone/.git/config` (location only; not used, not printed) |

## 8. Items that need Decision (Jev router) — not decided here

1. `MissionEditor.Cli` **→** `Ai.Host` **ProjectReference (#860).** Is an in-process reference consistent with ADR-030 ("thin CLI verbs calling a separate [Ai.Host](<http://Ai.Host>)"; rejected "AI inside the Mission Editor CLI")? Options: accept and amend ADR-030 to say so, require a process/IPC boundary, or waive with an exit ticket.
2. **ADR-013 status.** ADR-030 (Accepted) relies on ADR-013's dual-track CMO firewall, which is Proposed since Jul 3. Accept, amend, or record the dependency as provisional.
3. **Scores.** Confirm or replace all proposed scores (S5 4.5, S6 4.5, S7 4.0, S8 4.0, S9 4.0, S10 3.5; informational S1–S4 3.0/4.5/4.5/5.0) and the overall 4.08.
4. **Namespace-cycle policy.** No ADR forbids intra-assembly cycles, yet Delegation's cycles grew by 5 namespaces in S8–S10. Decide whether to adopt a rule (for example a frozen-baseline cycle test that fails CI on new cycles) or keep them as tracked debt.
5. **ADR acceptance hygiene.** Whether ADR status changes must land in their own docs PR before dependent code (ADR-015 in #863, ADR-017 backdated in #693, ADR-027 after #618).
6. **Doc sync.** Whether to require one PR that brings `architecture.md`'s ADR index and `architecture-traceability-index.md` up to ADR-030, and fixes ADR-006's TFM line.
7. **Stale Proposed ADRs.** ADR-023–026 (descope gates, Proposed since Sep 2): accept, reject, or park.
8. **ADR-010 §3 projection bypass** in Unity `C2TopBarPanelHost` (#669): accept as read-only presentation use, or require a projection.
9. **S1 governance.** Treat S1's \~95 direct pushes as historical baseline (recommended, since S2–S10 are 100% PR) or review after the fact; and whether to raise the main ruleset from 0 to ≥1 required approval.

## 9. Recommended remediation (for Decision to prioritise; none filed)

1. Add an architecture test that pins the csproj reference graph (ADR-001/006/010/030), so the hard boundaries that held by convention are enforced in CI.
2. Add a namespace-cycle test with today's SCCs frozen as a baseline; break the new Delegation `CombatEvents`/`Projection`/`SensorToShooter`/`TargetabilityAccept`/`ThreatAssessment` cycle first.
3. Resolve §8 items 1–2 and record the outcome in ADR-030 / ADR-013.
4. One docs PR: architecture.md ADR index to ADR-030, traceability index rows for 014–017 and 023–029, ADR-006 TFM.
5. Close the ADR-006 DATA-3 exception (`ScenarioPolicyRepository` in Sim) or restate it with a date.

Deadline: none set
Client: latest stable Grok Bot client (desktop 1.1.x / CLI grok 1.0.77+)

Claimed by CI config on Nov 20, 2026 at 6:03 AM CT.

Duplicate check (6:06 AM CT): searched open PRs, PRs closed in the last 14 days (#842–#879) and Linear. No match. <issue id="48c739d7-136d-4f7d-8435-3ad2c763e120" label="DRG-188" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-188/configure-notion-linear-github-and-graphite-traceability-workflow" /> is broader traceability work and <issue id="fe9a9a54-d706-4c68-9ce0-ed6db9c7b3da" label="DRG-241" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-241/hyg-09-dual-project-surface-labels-for-combat-ux-vs-cmano-clone" /> covers Linear surface/\* labels (not the CMANO Surface stamp), so neither is a duplicate.

## Design

A new hosted workflow (`ubuntu-latest`) that is non-required and triggers only on pull_request: `.github/workflows/pr-agent-gate.yml`.

* `contents: read` (plus `pull-requests: read` if needed).
* No `pull_request_target` and no checkout of PR code; it reads the event payload and the REST API with GITHUB_TOKEN.
* (a) Fail unless the title, branch, or body matches `DRG-\d+`. CMA- on its own does not count.
* (b) Parse the `Surface:` line in the PR body. Flag overlap with another open PR's Surface or changed files.
* A DRG-id PR with no Surface line fails (b).
* Flag any change to the hard-no surfaces: SimulationSession, DelegationBridge, CatalogWriteGate, MapPlaceholderPanelHost, GlobeMapProductHost.
* Renovate and dependabot PRs are skipped. Owner PRs still need a DRG id.

## Acceptance

* The hosted, non-required, pull_request-only workflow fails unless the title, branch, or body contains DRG-<n>.
* The same workflow flags overlapping Surface reservations and changed paths against other open PRs.
* Renovate and dependabot are skipped. Fork PRs are safe: no pull_request_target and no checkout of PR code.
* The check is not added to required checks until drg applies a ruleset or branch-protection edit after a Decision soak ruling.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### KCX-02 — Deterministic Contact Provenance & Source Attribution (lines 65-84)

Project ContactProvenanceState per active contact with Source (ObserverId, TargetId), lifecycle-derived Confidence (High/Medium/Low/Unknown), LastKnown snapshot, QualityState flags, and OutOfCommsUnknown. Headless subset exists; draft pending owner acceptance.

- [ ] \[KCX-02\] Fresh contacts publish ObserverId, TargetId, SourceRef, confidence level (Identified->High, Classified/degraded->Medium, Detected->Low), and LastKnown snapshot.
- [ ] \[KCX-02\] A contact whose TargetId is absent from catalog platforms or ORBAT reader sets ContactProvenanceQualityState.CatalogMiss.
- [ ] \[KCX-02\] Denied comms (CommsState.Denied) sets OutOfCommsUnknown=true and ContactProvenanceQualityState.SilentComms.
- [ ] \[KCX-02\] ContactProvenanceFingerprint.Compute produces bit-identical fingerprints across runs for identical inputs.

### KCX-03 — Track Custody, Staleness & Drop Lifecycles (lines 88-100)

Track continuity and custody deterministically via simulation ticks (DefaultStaleThresholdTicks=30, DefaultDropThresholdTicks=120, comms-accelerated staleness), emitting KillChainContactTransition events and TrackCustodyProjection. Draft pending owner acceptance.

- [ ] \[KCX-03\] Contact unrefreshed past StaleThresholdTicks (default 30, scaled by comms staleness divisor) transitions to Stale, emitting Degraded transition and breaking Track custody (StaleTrack).
- [ ] \[KCX-03\] Contact unrefreshed past DropThresholdTicks (default 120) transitions to Lost, emitting Lost transition and breaking Sensor link (LostSensor).
- [ ] \[KCX-03\] TrackCustodyProjection records deterministic custody state (Held vs Dropped), drop cause (LostSensor, Stale, CommsDenied, ExplicitDrop, Unknown), and transition ledger.

### KCX-04 — Targetability Composition & Fire-Control Verification (lines 104-117)

Determine contact targetability only when LocationSufficient, TrackContinuous, HasFireControlTrack, and Loss==None all hold, dropping Target phase on BDA degradation while preserving Track custody. Draft pending owner acceptance.

- [ ] \[KCX-04\] Identified target with active fire-control assignment publishes Phase=Target and links Targetability in SensorToShooterProjection.
- [ ] \[KCX-04\] Dropping fire-control fails link 3 (Targetability) with BreakCause=NoFireControl while preserving links 1 (Sensor) and 2 (Track).
- [ ] \[KCX-04\] BDA degradation (DegradedL1, DegradedL2) retains TrackContinuous in Phase=Track but drops Phase=Target and breaks Targetability with BreakCause=DegradedTrack.

- [ ] \[HOL-02\] Orders enqueued to PendingApprovalQueue MUST NOT execute until explicitly approved via TryApprove(orderId).

- [ ] \[HOL-02\] Approved orders drain via DrainApproved() and promote to ExecutedOrders on the subsequent simulation tick.

### HOL-03 — C2 Authority & Targeting Disposition Projection (lines 99-104)

- [ ] \[HOL-03\] All six core verbs (Observe, Recommend, Approve, Engage, Abort, Retask) MUST receive an explicit C2AuthorityActionState.

### HOL-05 — Agent C2 Skill Contract & Envelopes (lines 112-116)

Enforce structured skill envelope validation (SkillEnvelopeValidator, SkillCatalog, SkillIds) across segregated Read, Propose, and Submit lanes against known C2CommandIssuance verbs. Headless subset exists; draft pending owner acceptance.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### AGD-04 — Four Autonomy Levels with ROE/Policy Gate and Lethal Opt-In (lines 32-39)

Implement four autonomy levels (Manual, Assisted, SemiAutonomous, FullAutonomous) integrated with ROE/policy evaluation (AutonomyGate + RoePolicyAdapter), requiring explicit player opt-in per mission phase for full-autonomous lethal engagement.

- [ ] \[AGD-04\] AutonomyLevel defines Manual, Assisted, SemiAutonomous, and FullAutonomous tiers gated by AutonomyGate and IRoeFilter.
- [ ] \[AGD-04\] Full autonomous lethal engagement enforces explicit player opt-in per mission phase (aligned with PendingApprovalQueue / HOL).

### AGD-07 — Realistic Variability via Deterministic Trait-Weighted Softmax DecisionPipeline (lines 60-63)

Exhibit human-like decision variability (mistakes, hesitation, personality styles). DecisionPipeline softmax (Decisiveness), SeededRng, SlowerReactions (ReactionDelay\*5), and NarrowedFocus (Take(2)) are shipped, while ErrorRate, Aggression, and RiskTolerance candidate scoring remain unwired across DecisionPipeline and IPolicy implementations.

- [ ] \[AGD-07\] DecisionPipeline selects among candidate actions deterministically using SeededRng given identical seed, traits, candidates, and attention state.
- [ ] \[AGD-07\] ErrorRate (occasional mistakes), Aggression, and RiskTolerance drive candidate scoring and personality-specific decision styles in IPolicy/DecisionPipeline rather than remaining unwired.

### AGD-09 — Agent Delegation Responsiveness, Logging, and ROE Compliance NFRs (lines 69-75)

Ensure delegation remains responsive at thousands of entities without performance degradation, logs 100% of agent decisions for replay, and strictly respects ROE and player-defined constraints.

- [ ] \[AGD-09\] All agent intents pass through AutonomyGate and IRoeFilter before execution.
- [ ] \[AGD-09\] Delegation tick overhead remains bounded as entity count scales.

### AGD-11 — Agent Attention and Bandwidth Model with Graceful Degradation (lines 136-144)

Enforce per-agent attention budget (default 20, personality-modulated) scaling load by contacts/engagements/groups and degrading overloaded decisions. AttentionCalculator, SlowerReactions, and NarrowedFocus + IsOverloaded temperature scaling are shipped, while SimplerDecisions (>1.5x budget) is UI-only and overload integration tests are missing.

- [ ] \[AGD-11\] AttentionCalculator computes load from contacts, engagements, and group members against personality-modulated budget (default 20), with SlowerReactions and NarrowedFocus active.
- [ ] \[AGD-11\] SimplerDecisions drives simpler decision behavior in AgentController/DecisionPipeline (beyond UI projection) and overload degradation is covered by integration tests beyond AttentionCalculator.Evaluate.

### AGD-14 — Delegation Comms Degradation and Attention Coupling (lines 106-106)

Integrate CommsTimelineSimulator order delays and stale/datalink flags into agent observations and reduce effective attention budget under degraded comms (Phase 2), with EW Specialist preset balancing comms/EMCON tradeoffs.

- [ ] \[AGD-14\] Agents observe stale/datalink status flags from comms timelines without breaking determinism.
- [ ] \[AGD-14\] Degraded comms modulates effective attention budget per doc 19 integration.

### ROE-01 — Policy inheritance chain with provenance and cascade/lock controls (lines 31-46)

Resolve effective policy by specificity (unit, embarked, mission, group, side, scenario), expose it in UI/MCP, track override provenance, and cascade/lock parent edits. Headless unit->mission->side resolution and validation exist, while group/embarked inheritance, full provenance persistence, and cascade UI remain open.

- [ ] \[ROE-01\] Side ROE weapons tight with mission override weapons free resolves accurately per mission and unit, and embarked units inherit from their host or mission.
- [ ] \[ROE-01\] Effective policy inspection exposes resolved values and provenance (inherited, user, agent, event, scenario_template) across UI and tooling.
- [ ] \[ROE-01\] Parent policy edits support designer choice to cascade to or lock child overrides.

### ROE-04 — WRA per weapon/mount class (salvo, range bands, target categories) (lines 80-84)

Enforce Weapon Release Authority (WRA) per weapon type or mount class for max salvo, range bands, and target categories prior to engagement resolution, aborting with FireAbortReason.WRA\_\*. MaxSalvo enforcement and UI binder exist, while per-weapon/mount/range/target-category WRA tables remain unmodeled.

- [ ] \[ROE-04\] WRA max salvo limits block excess rounds (e.g., max salvo 2 blocks a 3-round salvo) with FireAbortReason.WraSalvo and display remaining salvo allowance in UI.
- [ ] \[ROE-04\] WRA range-band and target-category rules evaluate per weapon/mount class prior to engagement resolution and return FireAbortReason.WraRange or category denial codes.

### ROE-05 — EMCON per emitter class and mission EMCON schedules (lines 85-90)

Model per-emitter EMCON states (off, passive, active) across radar, sonar, ESM, datalink, and OECM affecting detection and enemy ESM, plus P1 mission-level EMCON schedules. Radar EMCON gating and HUD projection exist, while multi-emitter class inheritance and scheduled transitions remain incomplete.

- [ ] \[ROE-05\] EMCON passive or off on an emitter class prevents active emissions (such as active radar illumination) while allowing passive ESM reception and citing EMCON on fire abort.
- [ ] \[ROE-05\] Per-emitter EMCON controls cover radar, sonar, ESM, datalink, and OECM, and mission schedules transition EMCON deterministically at mission waypoints/phases.

### ROE-06 — Doctrine behavioral rules, withdraw/redeploy, posture, and special actions (lines 91-95)

Support mission doctrine (ignore course, opportunity targets, refuel/UNREP, withdraw on damage/ammo/bingo, nuclear gating) plus side posture and special-action gates. Damage-withdraw gates and assisted confirm UI exist, while full behavioral doctrine, fuel/ammo withdraw destinations, posture transitions, and nuclear/special gates remain open.

- [ ] \[ROE-06\] Exceeding configured damage, magazine, or bingo-fuel withdraw thresholds triggers a deterministic withdraw/redeploy decision or Assisted player confirmation prompt.
- [ ] \[ROE-06\] Ignore plotted course, engage opportunity targets, refuel/UNREP doctrine, hostile/neutral/friendly posture, and scenario-gated nuclear/special actions are enforced deterministically.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### CMD-04 — Top bar: sim time, compression, pause, mode, Begin Execution (lines 77-77)

Top bar displays simulation time, time compression, pause/run state, simulation mode, comms legend, and Begin Execution transition. `C2TopBarProjection`, `C2TopBarPanelHost`, and `C2ClockCommand` exist on disk, while compression model disambiguation (multiplier vs time-per-step) and Editor acceptance remain open.

- [ ] \[CMD-04\] Top bar displays formatted simulation time, phase, compression, mode, and comms state via C2TopBarProjection
- [ ] \[CMD-04\] Begin Execution transitions Planning to Executing cleanly and freezes planning-phase score counters prior to execution
- [ ] \[CMD-04\] Time compression model (multiplier vs time-per-step) explicitly standardized and Editor-verified (open residual)

### CMD-08 — Doctrine inheritance and effective policy panel (doc 13) (lines 81-81)

Doctrine panel displays effective ROE, salvo cap, EMCON, inheritance source chain (`unit -> embarked -> mission -> group -> side -> scenario`), and unit override control (`DoctrineInheritancePanelHost`, `DoctrineOverrideCommand`). Headless round-trip and UXML contract tests pass; Editor visual sign-off remains pending.

- [ ] \[CMD-08\] DoctrineInheritancePanelHost displays effective ROE, salvo, EMCON, and inheritance provenance for selected unit

### CMD-09 — Delegation badges and unit-level autonomy affordances (lines 82-82)

Unit-level delegation badge (`human` / `agent` / `mixed`), autonomy affordances, agent pause/resume, and OOB controller filters (`AgentRosterProjection`, `AgentRosterPanelHost`). Unit-granularity only (per-axis is `CMD-19`); side-level agent commander panel is Phase N.

- [ ] \[CMD-09\] Unit displays delegation badge with shape, short text, color token, and accessible label indicating human/agent/suspended state
- [ ] \[CMD-09\] Pausing or taking direct control suspends agent intent generation for that unit via C2PlayerCommandBridge

### CMD-16 — Persistent unit-order toolbar (lines 89-89)

Persistent unit-order toolbar exposing order verbs for the current selection without requiring right-click context menus. Note: Doc 20 marks this Open ('no host'), whereas `UnitOrderToolbarHost`, `UnitOrderToolbarPanel.uxml/.uss`, and `UnitOrderToolbarLayoutTests` exist on disk (Wave 1); full verb parity and Editor sign-off remain open.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### SWARM-18 — EMP and jamming soft-kill effects (Phase C, P2) (lines 248-251)

Partial+ (SwarmSoftKillApplicator EMP mode-freeze and jam linkState degradation shipped per swarm-c3); order-latency degradation has 0 hits in Sim/Swarm/ and ApplyJam does not touch CecMeshController.

- [ ] \[SWARM-18\] EMP scatters/freezes mode switches and jamming degrades linkState, order latency, and live CEC mesh membership deterministically.

### SWARM-22 — Scenario editor placement and configuration of swarms (Phase B, P1) (lines 189-194)

Partial+ (ScenarioDocumentEditor.PlaceSwarmUnit/ConfigureSwarmUnit and SwarmScenarioValidation shipped in Data); ScenarioValidationEngine never invokes SwarmScenarioValidation, PlaceSwarmUnit lacks ICatalogReader lookup, and CLI/Unity scenario editor have 0 swarm placement UI.

- [ ] \[SWARM-22\] ScenarioValidationEngine invokes SwarmScenarioValidation on loaded/authored scenarios to catch count > maxDrones, invalid host refs, and missing catalog refs.
- [ ] \[SWARM-22\] PlaceSwarmUnit resolves catalog bounds via ICatalogReader; CLI (orbat_upsert_unit) and Unity scenario editor support placing and configuring swarms with round-trip save/load.

### SWARM-23 — Agent delegation compatibility for swarm intent orders (Phase B, P1) (lines 195-200)

Delegated agents can issue intent orders via standalone SwarmAgentIntentIssuer (order-log actor attribution; swarm-b8 PASS), but SwarmAgentIntentIssuer has 0 production callers in DelegationOrchestrator.Tick()/DelegationBridge/AgentController and per-axis/unit delegation badges for swarms are unimplemented.

- [ ] \[SWARM-23\] Wire SwarmAgentIntentIssuer into DelegationOrchestrator.Tick() / AgentController so delegated agents issue swarm assault/screen orders in production runs with order-log actor attribution.
- [ ] \[SWARM-23\] Implement per-axis or unit-level delegation badges for swarm units matching doc 04.

### SWARM-26 — Contact classification distinguishing hostile swarms (CMD-29) (Phase B, P1) (lines 201-206)

Partial+ (standalone SwarmContactClassifier and SwarmContactLabel shipped in Sim/Sensors/ with unit tests per swarm-b5); 0 production callers in src/ or unity/—PdDetectionContactSimulator and ContactDetailProjection (CMD-29) remain unwired.

- [ ] \[SWARM-26\] PdDetectionContactSimulator and ContactDetailProjection (CMD-29) integrate SwarmContactClassifier to display swarm-class labels with confidence when sensor quality permits and allow misclassification at low quality.

### SWARM-31 — Cooperative Engagement Capability (CEC) for US and NATO platforms (Phase B, P1) (lines 207-235)

Partial+ (CecMeshController, CecMeshEvaluator, CecRemoteEngageGate, CatalogSwarmPlatform.CecCapable shipped); CatalogPlatformEntry lacks CecCapable/Nationality, Sim/Cec/* has 0 US/NATO nationality logic (P0 A-04), and 6/6 AC checkboxes are unchecked.

- [ ] [SWARM-31] US/NATO CatalogPlatformEntry platforms (ships, aircraft, land AA) and CEC-flagged swarms expose cecCapable with US/NATO affiliation gating while uas-swarm-generic stays non-CEC.
- [ ] [SWARM-31] Two CEC nodes form a composite track enabling a third CEC shooter to engage remotely under ROE/WRA/EMCON/DLZ.
- [ ] [SWARM-31] CEC mesh loss removes remote-engage eligibility with explicit reason while keeping linkState and cecMeshState independent in replay/QA.

## Requirement Breakdown & Detailed Acceptance Criteria

### ENV-02 — Terrain & radar-horizon line of sight (lines 29-29)

Model Earth-curvature radar horizon plus DEM-based terrain masking for low-altitude and ground units deterministically in Sim (<issue id="c6abedcf-f688-485e-bb59-c648bd12f101" label="DRG-379" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-379/env-02-terrain-and-radar-horizon-line-of-sight" />). Radar-horizon/terrain profile subset (LineOfSight.cs) exists; full DEM and owner review pending -> draft.

- [ ] \[ENV-02\] Detection loop rejects sensor-target pairs blocked by radar horizon or terrain with an explicit reason code.
- [ ] \[ENV-02\] Enforces a defined per-tick performance budget.

### EW-01 — Radar ECCM attributes (lines 42-42)

Add frequency-agile, PESA, and AESA flags and tech generation to catalog; resolve jammer vs radar generation matrix in ScenarioJamResolver (<issue id="1b03cb76-5412-486a-9e85-d6dac37aeae3" label="DRG-386" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-386/ew-01-radar-eccm-attributes" />). Code/test subset (RadarEccm.cs) exists; owner review pending -> draft.

- [ ] \[EW-01\] Catalog supports ECCM/tech-gen fields.
- [ ] \[EW-01\] ScenarioJamResolver behavior is verified via table-driven deterministic tests.

### C3-01 — Off-grid units in Sim (lines 49-49)

Promote Delegation/Comms state into Sim-authoritative comms-grid membership where off-grid units follow last orders/doctrine and reject new direct orders (<issue id="b236a2e1-ed5c-4ebe-bf31-f5f7bbe27a71" label="DRG-390" href="https://linear.app/drgamtd-workspace/issue/DRG-390/c3-01-off-grid-units-in-sim" />). Code/test subset (CommsGridRegistry.cs) exists; owner review pending -> draft.

- [ ] \[C3-01\] Command facade rejects new orders to off-grid units with an OffGrid reason.
- [ ] \[C3-01\] UI projection displays last-reported position for off-grid units.
